description: --hx-font-weight-regular does not exist in the token system. The correct token is --hx-font-weight-normal (400). Used in body, body-sm, body-lg, code, caption, and weight-regular variants.
fix: Replaced all 6 occurrences of var(--hx-font-weight-regular, 400) with var(--hx-font-weight-normal, 400)

description: --hx-radius-full does not exist. Correct token is --hx-border-radius-full (9999px).
fix: Replaced var(--hx-radius-full, 9999px) with var(--hx-border-radius-full, 9999px) in .meter__track border-radius

description: --hx-color-white does not exist in the token system. The correct semantic token for white is --hx-color-neutral-0 (#FFFFFF).
fix: Replaced both occurrences of var(--hx-color-white, #ffffff) with var(--hx-color-neutral-0, #ffffff) in nav link hover and active color

description: --hx-border-width-1 does not exist. The correct token is --hx-border-width-thin (1px).
fix: Replaced var(--hx-border-width-1) with var(--hx-border-width-thin) in .dialog__footer border-top

description: --hx-border-width-1 does not exist. The correct token is --hx-border-width-thin (1px).
fix: Replaced var(--hx-border-width-1, 1px) with var(--hx-border-width-thin, 1px) in .drawer-footer border-top

description: --hx-color-surface-overlay exists but resolves to rgba(0,0,0,0.75) — a black scrim — which is incorrect for an arrow background. The popup arrow should be white/surface-default, not the modal scrim color.
fix: Replaced var(--hx-color-surface-overlay, #ffffff) with var(--hx-color-neutral-0, #ffffff) in arrow background

description: z-index modal fallback was 100 instead of the correct token value 1400.
fix: Replaced fallback 100 with 1400 in z-index: calc(var(--hx-z-index-modal, 100) + 1)

description: --hx-size-128 does not exist in the token system. --hx-container-narrow resolves to 48rem; for dialog width 32rem we can use --hx-container-narrow as the closest available token.
fix: Replaced var(--hx-size-128, 32rem) with var(--hx-container-narrow, 32rem)

description: --hx-line-height-none does not exist in the token system. Line-height 1 for icon buttons has no matching token. Used in close button to prevent extra height.
fix: Replaced var(--hx-line-height-none, 1) with literal 1 and added audit-exception comment. Token gap: --hx-line-height-none or --hx-line-height-1 should be added to token system.

description: Same --hx-line-height-none issue as hx-dialog. Used in action button line-height.
fix: Replaced with literal 1 and exception comment.

description: z-index was hardcoded to 9999 instead of --hx-z-index-tooltip (1600). Transition duration 0.15s was hardcoded instead of --hx-transition-fast (150ms ease).
fix: z-index: var(--hx-tooltip-z-index, var(--hx-z-index-tooltip, 1600)). Transition now uses var(--hx-tooltip-transition-duration, var(--hx-transition-fast, 150ms ease))

description: Ghost inverted hover background used a raw rgba value not routed through the overlay token system.
fix: Replaced rgba(255,255,255,0.15) with var(--hx-overlay-white-20, rgba(255,255,255,0.2)) — nearest available overlay token

description: --hx-focus-ring-color already exists and resolves to --hx-color-primary-400 (#60A5FA). The fallback #2563eb (primary-500) was both the wrong color and bypassed the token chain. Fixed across: hx-alert, hx-banner, hx-checkbox, hx-code-snippet, hx-combobox, hx-date-picker, hx-link, hx-radio, hx-rating, hx-select, hx-side-nav (both), hx-slider, hx-split-button, hx-switch, hx-tab, hx-tab-panel, hx-text-input, hx-textarea, hx-toggle-button, hx-tree-view.
fix: Replaced all occurrences with var(--hx-focus-ring-color, var(--hx-color-primary-400, #60a5fa))

description: --hx-font-size-base does not exist in the token system. The correct token for 1rem base font size is --hx-font-size-md. Affected: hx-avatar, hx-checkbox, hx-table, hx-tag.
fix: Replaced all occurrences of var(--hx-font-size-base, 1rem) with var(--hx-font-size-md, 1rem)

description: --hx-size-2 does not exist in the token system (size tokens start at size-4). The equivalent spacing value 0.5rem is --hx-space-2. Affected: hx-badge, hx-meter, hx-slider.
fix: Replaced all occurrences of var(--hx-size-2, 0.5rem) with var(--hx-space-2, 0.5rem)

description: .tag used literal 1px for border-width instead of the token.
fix: Replaced with var(--hx-border-width-thin, 1px)

description: z-index: 1 in .drawer-panel is a local stacking context value to place the panel above the backdrop within the same overlay container. This is a legitimate exception — no global z-index token applies here.
fix: Added explanatory comment to clarify the exception intent

description: No token exists for line-height 1. --hx-line-height-tighter is 1.125, which is too large for icon buttons. A --hx-line-height-none: 1 token should be added to the token system.
z-index: 1 in step connector is a local stacking context. No global token applies.
fix: No change — this is a legitimate local stacking context exception

description: Local z-index 1 for sticky table headers within the table stacking context. No global token applies.
fix: No change — legitimate local stacking context

description: z-index: 2 for divider handle to appear above panels within shadow DOM stacking context. Legitimate local exception.
fix: No change — legitimate local stacking context

description: The 4px panel offset uses a hardcoded value. --hx-space-px (1px) exists but 4px = --hx-space-1 (0.25rem). The file is prettier-ignore minified so this is documented but not changed to avoid de-minifying the file.
tokenGapSuggestion: Consider replacing calc(100% + 4px) with calc(100% + var(--hx-space-1, 0.25rem)) in future refactor

description: Hardcoded 768px breakpoint in media query. The token --hx-breakpoint-md: 768px exists but CSS custom properties cannot be used in media query conditions. This requires a CSS preprocessor or JS approach.
fix: No change — CSS custom properties cannot be used inside @media conditions. Document as known limitation.

description: Same breakpoint issue as hx-nav. CSS custom properties cannot be used in media query conditions.
fix: No change — known CSS limitation
